summary: Bind inactive attention native capture storage and triggers to main

replay.detail: No source bootstrap, replay or automatic production registration is added.

schema.detail: Explicit inactive setup uses main-qualified tables, native descriptors and trigger targets. Disposable capture trigger/view SQL changes; an existing incompatible definition is refused, never silently replaced. No numeric Store schema transition or default installation.

rules.detail: Native admission, canonical ordering and projection rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Public APIs and production attention reads remain unchanged. Broader unqualified Installer calls are refused under metadata shadows; paired capture hooks use the library-compiled standalone main fence.

downtime.detail: No production source or startup callback is registered.

manual.detail: Existing installations require no action. Full native capture, physical eligibility, lifecycle and coverage remain prerequisites for future activation.

recovery.detail: A metadata shadow refuses reads/reclaim and the next paired begin fences the main source while preserving native admission. Dropping the shadow does not restore availability. No read-time repair or retained lifetime proof is added; storage errors require caller rollback and the unresolved managed writer cleanup contract.
